meaning.note: Read both complete original bodies and metadata, corrected the Japanese source and English translation, and independently reread both full revisions. terminology.note: Distinguished public-key encryption, signing and key agreement; message representative versus arbitrary payload; Euler theorem coprimality versus CRT proof; field modulus versus subgroup order and scalar; preimage versus second-preimage versus collision; fixed digest versus SHAKE XOF; signing/verification versus private-key encryption/public-key decryption; trust anchor, intermediate CA, certificate path and service name. mathematics.note: All ten display formulas match exactly, including phi and lambda conditions, bounded inverse d, RSA primitive range, coprime Euler step, complete per-prime/CRT argument, OAEP k-2*hLen-2=190 byte bound, prime-field p>3 nonzero discriminant, subgroup scalar range and chaining formula. Checked all 3,233 toy RSA representatives and both per-prime residues, the explicit non-coprime Euler counterexample and lambda inverse. Checked an order-19 toy elliptic curve with eighteen distinct nonidentity public points and 19G=infinity. Finite fixtures are not a general security proof or recommended curve.
